details: Target: Myo-ryung, adult feminine rabbit-themed human fighter. Silver-white hair with rose ribbons; exactly two very long white rabbit ears with pink inside, bent naturally to the sides; human face and hands/legs; white and warm pink sporty cropped jacket and top, pleated layer over fitted shorts, white knee socks with pink bands, oversized white/pink high-top sneakers. Keep original rose accessories. One small round white tail is permitted only if visible in side/rear view, never a long tail. Kick-ready fighting guard, grounded idle.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a SQUARE 2048 by 2048 transparent animation contact sheet.
Image 1 is the target's character identity (appearance only). Image 2 is Ja-Hyun's actual game idle frame, enlarged for proportion reference. Transfer the BODY CONSTRUCTION of image 2 to the identity of image 1.
Target: Myo-ryung, adult feminine rabbit-themed human fighter. Silver-white hair with rose ribbons; exactly two very long white rabbit ears with pink inside, bent naturally to the sides; human face and hands/legs; white and warm pink sporty cropped jacket and top, pleated layer over fitted shorts, white knee socks with pink bands, oversized white/pink high-top sneakers. Keep original rose accessories. One small round white tail is permitted only if visible in side/rear view, never a long tail. Kick-ready fighting guard, grounded idle.

EXACT SPECIFICATION:
- Exactly four rows, exactly four columns. Exactly sixteen separate complete right-facing grounded idle guard poses.
- Treat the page as 16 identical square cells. Each figure's head has EXACTLY the same size in every cell. Human body joint lengths are exactly constant in every cell. The last row must NOT be smaller than the first. Do not use perspective that shrinks later figures. Tiny breathing motion, subtle weight and guard shifts, ear/tail follow-through; two feet stay planted.
- Every figure occupies about 70% of its cell height, centered with ample 15% transparent margins on all sides. No cross-cell overlap. No ear, shoe, ribbon, hair or tail touches a cell border or the outer canvas.
- Match Ja-Hyun's head-to-body ratio: clearly visible torso and substantial bent human legs, same shoulder/head width relationship, arm and leg lengths and sneaker/head ratio. Around three-head-tall human skeleton, not two-head super-deformed. Preserve adult feminine facial identity.
- Same low, balanced, screen-right three-quarter guard angle as Ja-Hyun, normal human knees, natural human face and hands.
- Crisp clean NON-PIXEL polished semi-dimensional sprite art. Smooth clean alpha edges, zero loose dots or speckles, no colored fringe copied from reference transparency artifacts. Do not copy any reference image's background residue.
- Truly transparent RGBA, alpha 0 between every figure. No checkerboard pixels, no white/black/colored backdrop, no shadows, no floor, no text/labels/watermarks, no VFX, no opponent, no extra limbs/ears/tails, no mouse anatomy, no brand symbols.
The ONLY character in this output is the target, repeated as sixteen genuinely different idle animation poses. Keep ears and tail naturally curved beside/behind the body so their size does not force the human body to shrink.

details: Target: Yu-ran, adult feminine weasel-themed human fighter. Ash-silver hair, exactly two round brown weasel ears with white inner tufts, exactly one oversized long brown-and-white ringed tail, human face/hands/legs. Brown/white/black street jacket with fur collar, black cropped inner layer, white fitted shorts and black straps, black fingerless gloves, brown/white/black high-top sneakers, large black bow with teal ribbons and diamond belt gem. Preserve ring pattern and teal gems; tail remains large behind the body without compressing the human torso or legs. Wide tail-ready grounded fighting guard.
